On Mon, Oct 17, 2022 at 5:52 PM Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Thanks so much, Sophia!
On my end, happy to do an internal meeting on IRC with the members. Happy to be of service to you. I think maybe we
could do an hour before or after the public meeting.
I also think this issue is important to discuss at a high level in a public meeting - and could be raised as part of broader
DRG / AC conversation. I just don't know how it cannot be raised. There are ways to raise it and elevate it without
talking about the Council or anything internal at all. We at USAID are trying to strengthen the resilience in the
information and media space, partner with the tech sector to ensure tech supports democracy, and civil society broadly
to support democracies globally, address corruption, etc. Full disclosure - I am also giving a public talk on this topic this
week for the DOD audience.
cheers, Vera
